nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Aiko drifts closer. Your arms almost brush with every step.

choices.text: You’re the one who moved closer.
If I moved away… would you follow?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: You’re the one who moved closer.

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: N-No I didn’t. You imagined it.

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: Don’t apologize… I didn’t say it was bad.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: If I moved away… would you follow?

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: W-Wha—?! I’m not chasing you down the hallway!

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Judging by the way her eyes linger on you… she absolutely would.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Aiko’s hand swings close to yours—brushing, then pulling away, then brushing again. Almost like she’s testing the distance.

choices.text: If you’re cold, you can get closer.
You keep bumping into me—are you sure you’re okay?
Warm? You’re basically a space heater yourself.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: If you’re cold, you can get closer.

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: W-Why would you say that out loud…?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: You keep bumping into me—are you sure you’re okay?

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: I-I’m not bumping into you. You’re just… very in the way.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Warm? You’re basically a space heater yourself.

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: H-Hey! I’m not that warm—am I?

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Her fingers brush yours again—this time lingering a second longer before she quickly pulls away.
